profile.headline: Sr Embedded Software Engineer at Eaton

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.locationName: San Diego, California, United States · On-site
positions.description:
Design and development of diagnostic logging framework in multiple execution environment: TrustZone, UEFI and bootloader in Qualcomm SOCs as a part of NIST feature. 

Unit testing of features developed verifying detail architectural design and detect bugs at API and function level. 

Collaborate with deliverable teams/stakeholders to integrate and support system-level testing for developed features.

Troubleshooting and debugging complex issues reported by customers/clients related to core diagnostic services for DSP processors in Qualcomm SOCs. 

Debugging and solving issues and bug fixes for diagnostic windows drivers for SOCs. 

Assist the core platform testing team in designing test application/test plans for testing new features developed at API and function level. Also help improve test case plans for exiting software.

Proficient in Embedded Software development and debugging, C, Trace32, JTAG, API design, WinDbg, QXDM
positions.insights: Skills: Embedded Systems · Unit Testing · Real-Time Operating Systems (RTOS) · Debugging · C (Programming Language)

positions.title: Interim Engineering Intern
positions.locationName: San Diego, California, United States · On-site
positions.description:
• Developing and managing Jenkins framework for maintaining code mainline to simplify code management and maintenance.
• Automate code delivery and testing for diagnostics software from a single repository.
• Feature development to create tools plugin for executing tests and to accelerate individual unit test execution during development and unit testing.

positions.title: Graduate Teaching Assistant
positions.description:
•Working with Department of Electronic Engineering -Undergraduate and Graduate Labs for helping in coursework relevant to designing PCBs using EAGLE and helping test circuits mentioned in coursework and for project work.
•Coordinating various technical hands-on workshop on Arduino uno, Raspberry pi, PCB designing using EGALE, 3D printing and developing models using AUTOCAD.

company.name: The University of Texas at Arlington

positions.title: Research Assistant
positions.description:
•Monitoring brainwave signals, such as electroencephalogram (EEG) and Electromyography (EMG), provides the possibility of detecting fatigue conditions and warning of it in vital circumstances such as long way driving and monotonous exercises.
•Collected data and research related to bio-medical sensors such as EEG and EMG.
•The collected data is analyzed to provide the best method to detect the signals form human brain under different situation and to feed to an algorithm.

company.name: RFID and Auto-ID Deployment Lab - UTA

positions.title: Embedded System Intern
positions.description:
•Developed system using wired sensors to a detachable bus system to interface with the IOT gateway at the plant. Second, the sensors connections were wireless by RF wireless network. Troubleshoot issues with the gateway and try to optimize them and to get them fixed.
•Designed and implemented project using Arduino uno hooked up to ESP8266WiFi module and interface it with proximity sensor to take input data from running plants to better understand and feed input to the IOT gateway.

educations.schoolName: The University of Texas at Arlington

projects.title: Pulse Generator with Automatic Level Control
projects.description:
•	Built a very low-cost system using an ARM M4F core which can generate various signals on two analog outputs: sine, square, triangle, sawtooth and ramp waveforms with frequencies up to 40kHz 10V p – p. 
•	Firmware was developed in C, with a system having the ability to measure the amplitude with automatic level control and load impedance estimation on two analog inputs.
•	This project has a command line interface capable of controlling the system and providing measurement data back to the user with use of the peripherals such as UART, SPI, SSI, GPIO, Interrupts and IC’s such as MCP4821 DAC, TLV2374, IC 7660.

projects.title: RTOS For An ARM - M4F CORE
projects.description:
•	Designed a real-time operating system that implements a co-operative and pre-emptive system solution in a single framework, that supports round robin robin and priority scheduling.
•	It is designed to support task synchronization using semaphores. There are total ten tasks: yield, sleep, kill thread, finding the PID of task, CPU%, IPCS, PS, create thread, propriety scheduling and a shell interface.
•	Programmed ping-pong buffer to capture CPU utilization of each thread.
•	A command line interface can control the system using kernel level commands from shell which is designed to look and perform like a linux system.
